components.name: CharacterCard Entity
components.description: Room entity (character_cards table) defining a character persona. Fields: id, name, description, characterSetting (system/opening prompt), openingStatement (first message), otherContentChat (chat context), otherContentVoice (voice context), attachedTagIds (prompt tags), advancedCustomPrompt, marks (notes, not in prompt), chatModelBindingMode, chatModelConfigId, chatModelIndex, memoryProfileBindingMode, memoryProfileId, toolAccessConfig, isDefault, timestamps.

components.name: CharacterCardManager
components.description: Singleton manager for character card CRUD. Uses DataStore persistence. Manages card list, active card switching, default card initialization. Integrates with UserPreferencesManager (theme), WaifuPreferences, PromptTagManager, CustomEmojiRepository. Supports import/export with Gson JSON serialization.
key_operations: set active character card with real-time switching
configure tool access whitelist per card
bind card to specific model config or memory profile

components.name: CharacterCardToolAccessResolver
components.description: Resolves which tools/packages/skills/MCP servers a character card can access based on its toolAccessConfig

components.name: CharacterCardBilingualData
components.description: Bilingual (CN/EN) name and description data for character cards

components.name: CharacterGroupCard
components.description: Group/multi-character card that contains ordered list of GroupMemberConfig (characterCardId + orderIndex). Enables multi-character scenarios where multiple personas participate.

components.name: TavernCharacterCard (SillyTavern Format)
components.description: Full SillyTavern/Tavern character card format support (spec, data, character_book). Includes: name, description, personality, first_mes, avatar, mes_example, scenario, system_prompt, post_history_instructions, alternate_greetings, extensions (chub, depth_prompt, operit). The OperitTavernExtension preserves-card-specific Operit metadata during import/export.

components.name: TavernCharacterBook / TavernBookEntry
components.description: SillyTavern Lorebook/Worldbook format support with keys, secondary_keys, content, scan_depth, token_budget, recursive_scanning, selective_logic, probability, position, case_sensitive, constant flags

components.name: PromptTag / TagType
components.description: Tag system for attaching reusable prompt fragments to character cards. Different tag types (e.g., CUSTOM) control how prompts are injected.

components.name: PersonaCardChatHistoryManager
components.description: Manages chat history binding to character cards, enabling per-character persistent conversations

character_system_features.card_switching: Active card ID tracked in DataStore, real-time UI updates via Flow
character_system_features.import_export: Native Operit JSON + SillyTavern Character Card format (PNG/JSON with character_book)
character_system_features.model_binding: Per-card model config override (FOLLOW_GLOBAL or FIXED_CONFIG with specific configId)
character_system_features.memory_binding: Per-card memory profile override (FOLLOW_GLOBAL or FIXED_PROFILE)
character_system_features.tool_control: Per-card tool access whitelist (builtin tools, packages, skills, MCP servers)
character_system_features.group_cards: Multi-character group cards with ordered member list
character_system_features.default_character: Auto-created default 'Operit' character on first launch
character_system_features.worldbook_lorebook: Full SillyTavern character book entry system for knowledge injection

details: Operit v1.12.0 has a well-developed character/persona system. CharacterCards are Room entities (DataStore-backed) with detailed prompt sections (setting, opening, chat content, voice content, custom prompt). The system supports importing from and exporting to SillyTavern character card format (including the Lorebook/Worldbook system). Each card can independently bind to a specific model configuration and memory profile. A tool access resolution system allows restricting which AI tools/packages/skills each character can use. The CharacterGroupCard system enables multi-character conversations. CharacterCardManager is a singleton with Flow-based reactive state.
notes: Default character 'Operit' (id: default_character) is auto-created on first launch
Character settings are split into: characterSetting (system prompt), openingStatement (greet), otherContentChat/Voice (mode-specific), advancedCustomPrompt (supplementary)
Marks field is metadata only - NOT injected into the prompt
Tool access can be restricted per-card to specific builtin tools, packages, skills, or MCP servers
The OperitTavernExtension preserves Operit-specific metadata when round-tripping through Tavern card format
CharacterBook entries support: keys, selective logic, probability gating, position control, recursive scanning, constant mode
Chat model binding modes: FOLLOW_GLOBAL or FIXED_CONFIG (with specific configId)
Memory profile binding modes: FOLLOW_GLOBAL or FIXED_PROFILE (with specific memoryProfileId)
The system integrates with PromptTagManager for reusable prompt fragment attachments
CharacterGroupCardChatStats tracks usage statistics for group scenarios
